decisions.title: Record the applied Supabase EXECUTE restriction
decisions.scope: P0 security-control evidence only; no product schema or application behavior
decisions.decision: Record migration 20260828192126_p0_restrict_rls_auto_enable_execution as an already-applied security control while preserving the function body, SECURITY DEFINER property, ensure_rls event trigger, schema design, and all other privileges.
decisions.rationale: The supplied post-remediation evidence shows direct EXECUTE is false for anonymous and authenticated roles, true for postgres and service_role, ensure_rls remains enabled for ddl_command_end, and both Supabase advisors returned no findings.

decisions.title: Bound physical Migration 1 to application identity
decisions.decision: Implement physical Migration 1 with the public users application-identity relation, server-generated UUID and timestamps, a restricted timestamp trigger function, explicit Data API grants, and immediate RLS. Add no profile, capability, jurisdiction, provider, or later-phase relation and no additional extension without a concrete locked dependency.
decisions.rationale: The locked physical sequence places auth/application identity in Migration 1. The users relation is the smallest locked application identity, while client, attorney, staff, capability, and session relations have explicit later migration owners. PostgreSQL 17 already provides gen_random_uuid and both active projects already contain the required Supabase platform extensions, so adding another extension would be speculative.
decisions.impact: Records the protected-review-approved P1 Migration 1 application to Rosuno Staging only; it is not a production release or deployment and does not authorize later P1 work.

decisions.title: Accept physical Migration 2 authorization foundation
decisions.scope: P1/1B authorization foundation only; reviewed Rosuno Staging application
decisions.decision: Accept the protected-review-approved Migration 2 artifact and its persistent Rosuno Staging application as the historical authorization foundation. The original six-table scope and pre-review evidence remain historical records; the later sequence-5 correction is the forward-only authority for the current four-table P1-002 surface.
decisions.rationale: PR #4 approved and merged the original migration before persistent Staging application, and PR #6 separately approved and merged its validation evidence. The later scope defect does not erase that lifecycle: it was reopened and corrected forward-only through the accepted sequence-5 migration without rewriting the original SQL or pre-review evidence.
decisions.impact: Records the reviewed historical P1-002 Staging application and its later forward-only correction. It does not authorize production activity, OLD access, P1-004, or restoration of the removed profile tables.

decisions.title: Accept physical Migration 3 regulatory control foundation
decisions.scope: P1/1C jurisdiction, policy, and launch-gate foundation only; accepted Rosuno Staging application
decisions.decision: Accept the protected-review-approved Migration 3 artifact and its one-time persistent Rosuno Staging application. The accepted boundary contains only jurisdiction-neutral jurisdictions and service areas, regulatory modes and their effective-dated jurisdiction relationships, versioned policy configuration with authority provenance, launch gates, evaluations, explicit launch authorizations, and the deferred restrictive capability-grant jurisdiction foreign key.
decisions.rationale: Locked Physical Migration 3 owns this regulatory control plane. Final acceptance confirmed exact migration history and catalog structure, default-deny client security, zero seed data, intact prior controls, and no unapproved advisor finding. Counsel-gated values remain unseeded, verified authority provenance remains mandatory before policy approval, and LIVE jurisdiction status still requires an independent active launch authorization.
decisions.impact: Records the accepted non-production application of Migration 3 to Rosuno Staging only; it is not a production release, does not authorize counsel-gated configuration, and does not authorize P1-004 or later work.

decisions.title: Accept the bounded P1-002 authorization scope correction
decisions.scope: P1-002 authorization scope correction only; accepted Rosuno Staging application
decisions.decision: Accept the protected-review-approved sequence-5 product schema correction and its one-time persistent Rosuno Staging application. The correction removes the two unauthorized profile tables, narrows the retained authorization surface to staff_profiles, capability_definitions, capability_grants, and application_sessions, and preserves the P1-003 capability-grant jurisdiction contract.
decisions.rationale: The correction passed the preserved rollback-only validation, was approved and merged through PR #10, and its one-time Rosuno Staging application passed all 39 post-application checks. The exact five-version migration history, corrected catalog fingerprint, retained P1-003 foreign key and comment, zero relevant rows, approved INFO advisor identities, and non-target boundaries were verified without rewriting historical evidence.
decisions.impact: Records the accepted, reviewed, merged, and once-applied P1-002 correction in Rosuno Staging only. It does not authorize production activity, OLD access, or P1-004 or later work.

decisions.decision: Correct the current P1-002 governance records to reflect the protected review, persistent Staging application, later defect discovery, forward-only scope correction, and final closure. decisions.decision: Implement exactly consultation_requests, availability_rules, blackouts, slot_holds, bookings, instant_availability_intents, and bookability_evaluations using the frozen P1-007 physical contract. Preserve scheduled-versus-instant request semantics, transaction-boundary Request/Hold consistency, server-authoritative Hold lifecycle and scheduling conflict guards, session-bound Instant Availability Intent, immutable point-in-time Bookability evidence, and fail-closed least privilege. Under the separately approved P1-007 interpretation gates, bookings.consultation_id is required in P1-007 without a Booking-to-Consultation foreign key; P1-008 must add that restrictive foreign key forward-only after consultations exists. Recurring Availability requires effective_from, permits null effective_until as open-ended, and requires effective_until >= effective_from when an end is present.

decisions.title: Define the P1-009 Gate 5 reproducible prestate verification contract
decisions.scope: Gate 5A verification-contract implementation only; no database execution, migration change, rollback change, persistent application, closure, Production, OLD, or later P1 work.
decisions.decision: Preserve the accepted P1-008 baseline and fingerprint as immutable historical evidence with an explicit unrecovered generating-query provenance gap. Define a new versioned P1-009 Gate 5 prestate contract with a retained exact query artifact, exact table/function/principal scope, pinned rosuno-p1-catalog-v1 canonicalization source identity, and required raw/canonical PRE and POST execution evidence. The new PRE fingerprint is a P1-009 Gate 5 execution anchor only and does not reproduce, replace, repair, or supersede the historical P1-008 fingerprint.
decisions.rationale: The historical P1-008 fingerprint result remains accepted, but exhaustive read-only recovery did not prove its exact generating query or raw execution artifact. Forward-only remediation preserves history while making P1-009 Gate 5 independently reproducible and fail-closed.
decisions.impact: Adds only reproducible Gate 5 verification tooling and contract evidence. It does not authorize Gate 5 database execution or change any P1-009/P1-008 migration, rollback, baseline, release, or closure state.
